# TextBox

Header: `winui/ui/text/TextBox.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/text/TextBox.hpp`.

Single- or multi-line editable text.

A focusable field with a blinking caret, mouse and keyboard selection, and Ctrl+C/X/V through the host's [Clipboard](../tree/clipboard.md). When the host provides a [SpellChecker](../rendering/spell-checker.md), misspellings get squiggles and a context menu of suggestions. It can show a header above the field and a placeholder while empty. [set_accepts_return()](#set_accepts_return) or [set_wrapping()](#set_wrapping) make it multi-line. A multi-line box grows a line at a time and scrolls when it is shorter than its text. [set_password_char()](#set_password_char) makes it [PasswordBox](password-box.md#uipasswordbox)'s edit part. [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) reports user edits only, never [set_text()](#set_text). In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::TextBox`](#uitextbox).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> name{"Ada"};
ui::Control<ui::TextBox> notes;

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::TextBox{.header           = "Name",
                    .placeholder_text = "Your name",
                    .text             = name,
                    .on_submit        = [&] { /* save name.get() */ }},
        ui::TextBox{.header         = "Notes",
                    .accepts_return = true,
                    .wrapping       = ui::TextWrapping::Wrap,
                    .height         = 120,
                    .control        = notes},
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(name, [](const std::string& n) { return "Hello, " + n; })},
    },
});

// Or imperatively:
auto  stack = std::make_unique<ui::StackControl>(ui::Orientation::Vertical);
auto* code  = stack->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextBoxControl>());
code->set_header("Activation code");
code->set_max_length(8);
code->set_character_casing(ui::CharacterCasing::Upper);
code->set_spell_check(false);
code->on_text_changed([](const std::string& text) { /* validate */ });
```

## `ui::TextBox`

An editable text field, single-line by default. Builds a [ui::TextBoxControl](#uitextboxcontrol).

[`.text = prop`](#uitextbox-text) is two-way: the box shows the property, and what the user types is written back into it before [`.on_text_changed`](#uitextbox-on_text_changed) runs. A bind with a conversion, a `const` property and [`ui::bind_one_way()`](../core/namespace-ui.md#bind_one_way) only display the value. [`.accepts_return`](#uitextbox-accepts_return) or a [`.wrapping`](#uitextbox-wrapping) other than NoWrap make it multi-line.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> name{"Ada"};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::TextBox{ .header           = "Name",
                     .placeholder_text = "Your name",
                     .text             = name,
                     .max_length       = 40,
                     .width            = 240,
                     .on_submit        = [] { save(); } },
        ui::Text{ .text = ui::bind(name, [](const std::string& n) { return "Hello, " + n; }) },
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::TextBox{
    .header, .description, .error, .placeholder_text, .text, .max_length, .spell_check,
    .read_only, .accepts_return, .accepts_tab, .character_casing, .wrapping, .font_family,
    .font_size, .font_weight, .italic, .character_spacing, .foreground,
    .selection_highlight_color, .unfocused_selection_highlight_color, .color_spans,
    .line_numbers, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled,
    .accessibility, .on_text_changed, .on_edit, .on_submit, .on_selection_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

## `ui::TextBoxControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::ValueProvider`.

Single- or multi-line editable text.

A focusable field with a blinking caret, mouse and keyboard selection, and Ctrl+C/X/V through the host's [Clipboard](../tree/clipboard.md). When the host provides a [SpellChecker](../rendering/spell-checker.md), misspellings get squiggles and a context menu of suggestions. It can show a header above the field and a placeholder while empty. [set_accepts_return()](#set_accepts_return) or [set_wrapping()](#set_wrapping) make it multi-line. A multi-line box grows a line at a time and scrolls when it is shorter than its text. [set_password_char()](#set_password_char) makes it [PasswordBox](password-box.md#uipasswordbox)'s edit part. [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) reports user edits only, never [set_text()](#set_text). In a spec tree it is built by [`ui::TextBox`](#uitextbox).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> name{"Ada"};
ui::Control<ui::TextBox> notes;

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::TextBox{.header           = "Name",
                    .placeholder_text = "Your name",
                    .text             = name,
                    .on_submit        = [&] { /* save name.get() */ }},
        ui::TextBox{.header         = "Notes",
                    .accepts_return = true,
                    .wrapping       = ui::TextWrapping::Wrap,
                    .height         = 120,
                    .control        = notes},

    },

// Or imperatively:

code->set_max_length(8);

code->on_text_changed([](const std::string& text) { /* validate */ });

```

### SpellCheckDelayMs


### MaxSpellingSuggestions

```cpp
static std::size_t MaxSpellingSuggestions = 5
```

The most spelling suggestions the context menu lists, best first.

### CaretBlinkIntervalMs

```cpp
static double CaretBlinkIntervalMs = 530.0
```

How long the caret stays shown, and then hidden, in ms. The user's blink setting is not read.

### set_chromeless

```cpp
void set_chromeless(bool chromeless)
```

A chromeless box draws no background fill, border stroke or focus underline, only the text, selection and caret, so a host control ([ComboBox](combo-box.md#uicombobox)) can paint one background and border under its whole surface.


[Tab](tabs.md#uitab) inserts a tab character instead of moving focus, while the box is editable. Shift+Tab then does nothing. An [`on_key_down`](../tree/element.md#on_key_down) handler can take both keys to indent and outdent.

### color_spans

```cpp
const std::vector<TextColorSpan>& color_spans() const
```

Colors for ranges of the text; empty by default.

### set_color_spans

```cpp
void set_color_spans(std::vector<TextColorSpan> spans)
```

Draws ranges of the text in their own colors, as a syntax highlighter does. The selection still draws over them. Ranges are byte offsets. The spans are sorted and overlaps are cut. An edit moves the spans after it and stretches or cuts the ones it touches, so they stay on their text until the next call. Multi-line boxes only.

### set_line_numbers

```cpp

```


```cpp
void on_text_changed(Callback<void(const std::string&)> handler)
```

Fired after any user-driven edit (typing, Backspace, Delete, cut, paste, undo and redo) and after [replace_selection()](#replace_selection), [undo()](#undo) and [redo()](#redo), with the new text. [set_text()](#set_text) raises nothing.

### on_edit

```cpp
void on_edit(Callback<void(const TextBoxEditArgs&)> handler)
```

Fired for every change to the text, with what changed: typing, pasting, undo and redo, [replace_selection()](#replace_selection) and [set_text()](#set_text) too. Runs right after the change, before [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) and before the caret moves. Don't edit the box from it. Use it to feed an incremental parser.

### on_submit

```cpp
void on_submit(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired when the user presses Enter, unless [accepts_return()](#accepts_return) makes Enter insert a line break.

### on_selection_changed

```cpp
void on_selection_changed(Callback<void()> handler)
```

Fired when the caret or the selection moved, by a key, the pointer, an edit or a call.

### select

```cpp
void select(std::size_t anchor, std::size_t caret)
```

Selects from `anchor` to [`caret`](#caret) (byte offsets; the caret goes to [`caret`](#caret), so an anchor after it selects backwards). Both are clamped to the text and moved back to a character boundary. The view scrolls to the caret.

### select_all

```cpp
void select_all()
```

Selects the whole text.

### selected_text

```cpp
std::string selected_text() const
```

The selected text; empty with nothing selected.

### replace_selection

```cpp
void replace_selection(std::string_view text)
```

Replaces the selection with [`text`](#text), or inserts it at the caret, and puts the caret after it. An edit like a typed one: it can be undone and raises [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed). Neither read_only nor max_length stops it.

### can_undo

```cpp
bool can_undo() const
```

Whether there is an edit [undo()](#undo) can take back. Ctrl+Z does the same.

### can_redo

```cpp
bool can_redo() const
```

Whether there is an undone edit [redo()](#redo) can make again. Ctrl+Y and Ctrl+Shift+Z do the same.

### undo

```cpp
void undo()
```

Takes back the last edit and puts the caret and the selection back where they were before it; nothing when [can_undo()](#can_undo) is false. Typing is undone a word at a time, a run of Backspace or Delete presses at once.

### redo

```cpp
void redo()
```

Makes the last undone edit again; nothing when [can_redo()](#can_redo) is false.

### clear_undo_history

```cpp
void clear_undo_history()
```

Forgets every edit, so [undo()](#undo) has nothing to take back. [set_text()](#set_text) does this too, so a loaded document starts with an empty history.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring reads only the box's own state, the measurer and the theme.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the box has keyboard focus (caret shown, blink running).

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

Focusable while enabled (a read-only box too, for selecting and copying).

### spell_check

```cpp
bool spell_check() const
```

Whether spell checking is on; true by default. Without a [SpellChecker](../rendering/spell-checker.md) from the host it does nothing either way.

### set_spell_check

```cpp
void set_spell_check(bool enabled)
```

Turns spell checking on or off; turning it off drops every squiggle at once.

### spelling_errors

```cpp
const std::vector<SpellingError>& spelling_errors() const
```

The current misspellings, sorted by start. Includes the word being typed, which gets no squiggle until it's finished.

### sync_spell_checker

```cpp
void sync_spell_checker(SpellChecker& checker) override
```

Keeps the host's [SpellChecker](../rendering/spell-checker.md) and schedules a full check with it. The [Window](../tree/window.md) calls this as the box gains focus. The box doesn't own the checker.

### handle_context_menu

```cpp
bool handle_context_menu(std::optional<Point> position, ContextMenuHost& host) override
```

Shows spelling suggestions, "Add to dictionary" and "Ignore" over a squiggle, then Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All, each enabled when it can act.

### caret_visible

```cpp
bool caret_visible() const
```

The current blink phase: whether a focused box draws its caret right now.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Always AutomationRole::Edit.

### caret_bounds

```cpp
std::optional<Rect> caret_bounds() const override
```

The caret, one DIP wide and a line tall, while focused and editable.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

As wide as the text or placeholder plus padding and buttons, at most `available.width`. As tall as its lines plus padding, at least the theme's minimum text box height while [set_uses_theme_min_height()](#set_uses_theme_min_height) is on. The header and description add their own room.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places the header and the field; a multi-line box re-flows its text to the new width.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

Click to place the caret, drag / Shift+click to select, double-click a word, triple-click everything. The delete button clears the text.

### wheel_override

```cpp
bool wheel_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A multi-line box taller than its view scrolls on the wheel, and shows a scroll bar.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Toggles caret visibility every CaretBlinkIntervalMs while focused.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Background, border and focus underline (unless chromeless), header, placeholder or text, selection highlight, squiggles, caret and delete button.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Called by the [Window](../tree/window.md) as focus moves; restarts the caret blink on a gain.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Caret movement and selection keys, Backspace/Delete, Enter (submit or line break), Ctrl+A/C/X/V, and Ctrl+Z right after an autocorrection.

### text_override

```cpp
bool text_override(const TextInputEvent& text_event) override
```

Inserts typed UTF-8 text at the caret (replacing the selection) and fires [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed); control characters are dropped, [CharacterCasing](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#charactercasing) and MaxLength apply.

### draws_focus_ring

```cpp
bool draws_focus_ring() const override
```

None: the field shows focus with its accent border.

## struct TextBoxEditArgs

What a [TextBox](#uitextbox)'s `on_edit` gets: [`removed`](#struct-textboxeditargs) at [`position`](#struct-textboxeditargs) became [`inserted`](#struct-textboxeditargs). Byte offsets into the text before the change; the views are valid during the call.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Where the change starts. |
| `removed` | `std::string_view` |  | The text that was there. |
| `inserted` | `std::string_view` |  | The text that is there now. |
